title: Override Time
description: Override the time and weather on the client.
body:
This is a Port of [Client Time](https://modrinth.com/mod/clienttime)

This mod lets you change the time and weather of your world.

it is only client-side so if you play it on a server it doesnt effect other players.

in order to make this mod function you need to set a keybind for it in the keybinds menu.
